ANSWER: NO
HALLUCINATIONS: None

All key financial terms in the memo are supported by the source document:

- Date of Agreement: November 30, 2020 ✓
- Borrower: MGE Niagara Entertainment Inc. ✓
- Administrative Agent: Bank of Montreal ✓
- Guarantor: Complex Services Inc. ✓
- Original Credit Agreement dates: June 10, 2019 (amended July 17, 2019) ✓
- Extended Waiver Period: Through March 31, 2021 ✓
- Financial covenants referenced: Sections 9.4.1 and 9.4.2 ✓
- Closure duration: >60 consecutive days ✓
- OLG relief letter dates: April 19, June 11, June 12, 2020 ✓
- Compliance certificates waived for Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4 and Annual Business Plan ✓

The memo appropriately notes "N/A" for deal terms not specified in the waiver document (deal size, price, interest rate, maturity date, payment frequency), which is accurate since this is a waiver document rather than the original credit agreement. All substantive financial and legal terms are properly sourced from the document.

ANSWER: YES
MISSING_TERMS: 
- Extension fee of 5 basis points on the Commitment of each Lender
- Minimum Liquidity requirement of $15,000,000 
- Applicable Margin deemed to be at Level 5 (5.00% for Bankers' Acceptances/Letters of Credit/LIBOR Loans, 3.50% for Prime Rate Loans/USBR Loans, 1.25% Undrawn Fee)
- Prohibition on requesting Advances under either Credit Facility
- Weekly liquidity reporting requirement (by Tuesday of each week)
- Event of Default triggers related to OLG payment interruptions (more than 5 Business Days for either Threshold payment relief or Fixed Component Per Diem payments)
- Restrictions on Distributions pursuant to clauses (c) and (e) of Permitted Distributions
- Restrictions on amending Leases, MGE Management Agreement, CNHI Consulting Agreement, or Convertible Debentures
- Prohibition on Acquisitions
